contracts.commit_point: `self._now = target` immediately followed by `self._trace.append(self._now)` at working_dir.py lines 43-44, executed only after all three rejection branches have been passed.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Pre-commit validation inside WorkingDir.change_to_child_dir: (1) membership check `if target not in self._now.iterdir()` raising FileNotFoundError; (2) `if not target.is_dir()` raising NotADirectoryError; (3) `if target.is_symlink()` raising NotADirectoryError; the @tool wrapper catches any exception raised by these checks and returns a failure string, so the commit statements are reached only when all three checks pass.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Committing a working-directory change to a target that (a) is not found among the current directory's direct children (target not in self._now.iterdir() -> FileNotFoundError), (b) exists but is not a directory (not target.is_dir() -> NotADirectoryError), or (c) is a symlink (target.is_symlink() -> NotADirectoryError) — i.e., traversal or symlink-based escape beyond the current position, which the class docstring declares as preventing unauthorized (ultra vires) access to the file system outside the tool's permitted scope.
